name: Actingfor Pattern
description: To represent that some agent is acting in order to forward the action of a social (non-physical) agent.
scenarios: Matteo Sanvitale is working as an officer for CEMA s.r.l.
competency_questions: Who is working for which organization? Who is representing the company?
